background: Bank of Ireland Group is the holding company of Ireland's other dominant retail and business bank, funded by Irish deposits and lending on Irish and UK mortgages and to Irish companies, with a UK consumer finance arm.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, A- on average and both on a stable outlook, after one of the three withdrew its rating on 25 Mar 2026. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 191% and NSFR of 156% both in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks, and leverage of 6.8% is in the top quarter too. CET1 of 14.7% is below the peer median and has fallen 0.5 points since 30 Jun 2025, the one ratio moving the wrong way. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
